name: Kijou Madoka
source:
A frivolous guy who flirts with any cute girl he sees. But in reality, he is a hardworking boy who lives on his own and commutes to school while working part-time at a gas station. He is full of conversation topics and loves anything to do with having fun. He treasures a motorbike that he says an older student passed down to him.

[Translated from the [url=http://www.tokimemo-type.com/tkmkgstype/character/index.html]official website[/url]]
